lead.headline: Golden trends toward playing; his fallback is limited again
lead.deck: 1-6. The lineup is the projection lineup. Check Green Bay's inactives at 16:45.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. George Pickens, the fallback if Matthew Golden sits tonight, was limited again on Thursday with the shoulder and the hamstring, and Friday's Cowboys report decides whether he gets a designation. The better news broke after the morning brief: Ian Rapoport reports Golden is trending towards playing, and James Palmer that the Packers expect him to suit up. He is still officially questionable with a shoulder and a foot, so the plan stands: check the inactives at 16:45; if Golden is out, start Pickens before the 18:15 kickoff, and Rashee Rice covers if Pickens is then ruled out. Josh Jacobs has no designation and leads the backfield tonight. 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.1, 53%.

doFirst.headline: One check left: Golden at 16:45 tonight

doFirst.empty: Nothing to decide until Green Bay's inactives at 16:45.
